title: Defective. Black Powder Leaking Everywhere
text: Defective. Black Powder Leaking Everywhere. Immediately out of the package, black powder got everywhere. All over the plastic, my kitchen counter, and my hands. You can see from the photo that the charcoal has also escaped from the holes and clumped together. This filter is unusable. I absolutely do not recommend to buy this filter.
